21-10-31
C.I. 187
FILED
DATE 4/11/31

To Deputy Commissionerachine,

Sir.
Re attached I beg to report that
I saw the man's son at 79 Rue Bourgeat
French Town & told him that I was sent
by you the C.I. Crime to get the facts
regarding the alleged "Gratuity."
He informed me, however, he did not
give the gratuity to C.A.I. Oh as alleged in
his father's letter, nor he was aware that
any one of his family did it.
Upon being asked whether he cared
to see you personally he said he would
be glad to do so if it was necessary. Today
he could not come because it is his
father's first "Seven".
The son appears to be around 25.
fairly well educated, & rather intelligent,
and it seems that his statement bears
resemblance of truth.
They are now living in a small
room above a cigarettes shop.

I am, Sir
Your obedient Servant.
Eze Lewhim
D.I.

（批：Jld / Ken / 8/10）
pages.zh:
31-10-21
C.I. 187
已归档
日期 31年11月4日

致副总监马钦先生，

先生。
关于附件，谨此报告，
我在法租界宝尔热路（Rue Bourgeat）79号见到了该人之子，并告知他，我是受您（刑事调查处总监）派遣，前来核实有关所谓“酬金”的事实。
然而，他告知我，他并未如其父信中所称那样将酬金交给刑事调查员罗（C.A.I. Oh），也不知晓其家人中有谁做过此事。
当被问及是否愿意亲自见您时，他说如有必要，他很乐意前来。今天他无法前来，因为今天是他父亲的第一个“七”（头七）。
该子年龄约25岁，受过良好教育，相当聪明，其陈述似乎属实。
他们现在住在一间香烟铺楼上的小房间里。

先生，
您顺从的仆人。
Eze Lewhim
侦探督察

（批注：Jld / Ken / 10月8日）

pages.en:
Translation of the attached letter written by Convict
No. E. 36, Tsa Soong ping, on 15-10-31.

My dear son Leu,

When I was in the Police Station, I
learned that you raised through successive efforts a
sum of $5000 and handed it to Loh Lien Kwei as 'gratuity'
to guarantee for my release.

I am now going to be executed. As the
money was obtained from loans and pawnshops for articles
pledged, you should ask him for its return and use it to
repay the loans, to meet expenses required for transport-
ing my remains to our native province Kiangsi and to
support yourself. You must be self-supporting and must
make immediate efforts to secure a means of livelihood.
Don't neglect this my will.

In case should C.D.I. Loh refuse to
admit it, my 'teacher' Pao Foong (寶峯), Wong Ching Sung
(黃金聲) (? C.D.S. 62) (this name has the same pronoun-
ciation as that of the C.D.S. with slight difference in
the surname) and Tsang Kuan Yah (張冠俠), through whose
hands the money was paid, will not, I think, deny it. I
hope that you will hand this letter to Pao, Tsang and Wong
for their perusal first and that they will, for their
conscience sake, testify the truth. I shall then die in
peace.

From your father.
October 15, 1931.
pages.zh:
附件信件译文，由罪犯
E. 36号，曹松平（Tsa Soong ping），于31年10月15日撰写。

吾儿乐（Leu）亲启，

我在警察局时，
得知你经过多方努力筹集了
5000元，并作为“酬金”交给罗连贵（Loh Lien Kwei），
以保释我出狱。

我即将被执行死刑。既然这笔钱
是通过借贷和典当物品所得，你应向他追回此款，用于
偿还债务，支付将我的灵柩运回原籍江西省的费用，以及
维持你的生活。你必须自食其力，并立即设法谋生。
切勿违背我的遗愿。

如果刑事调查员罗（C.D.I. Loh）拒绝承认，
我的“老师”宝峯（Pao Foong）、黄金声（Wong Ching Sung）
（？刑事侦探警长 C.D.S. 62）（此名与那位刑事侦探警长发音相同，
仅姓氏略有不同）以及张冠侠（Tsang Kuan Yah），钱款经他们之手转交，
我想他们不会否认。我希望你先将此信交给宝、张、黄三人阅看，
希望他们出于良心作证说明真相。如此我便能死得安心。

父字。
1931年10月15日。

pages.en:
Rough translation of attached letter
written by Convict No. E. 36, Tsa Soong Bing,
on 15.10.31.

My dear son, Lou,

When I was in Police Station
you have borrowed $5,000.00 from people and
handed to Loh Lien Kwei (Detective Chief
Inspector) as a gratuity to guarantee my release.
Now I am going to be executed, you ought to ask
him to return you the money so that you can repay
those whom you borrowed from. Any money remained,
you may spent it for my funeral expenses. You
must try to earn your own living and be self-
supported. Hoping you will NOT betray my will.

In case the Detective Chief Inspector Loh
denies this affair, you can call Messrs. Pao Foong
Snai, Jong Ching Sung and Chang Kwan Hsiu to dis-
close their heart (to bear witness) as they paid
the money to him. They will not deny it. Then
I will die in peace.

Father's word.
15th October.

CSC.
pages.zh:
附件信件粗译，
由罪犯 E. 36号，曹松兵（Tsa Soong Bing），
于31年10月15日撰写。

吾儿娄（Lou）亲启，

我在警察局时，
你向他人借了5,000.00元，
并作为酬金交给罗连贵（侦探总督察），
以保释我出狱。
现在我即将被执行死刑，你应当要求
他退还你这笔钱，以便你偿还那些
向你出借的人。剩余的钱，
你可用作我的丧葬费用。你
必须努力谋生，自食其力。望你
切勿违背我的遗愿。

如果侦探总督察罗
否认此事，你可以请宝峯先生（Pao Foong Snai）、
钟景松（Jong Ching Sung）和张冠秀（Chang Kwan Hsiu）先生
吐露心声（作证），因为钱是他们经手交给他的。
他们不会否认。这样
我就能死得安心。

父谕。
10月15日。

CSC.
